name: Infosys

rounds.name: Online Test (InfyTQ / Online Assessment)
rounds.detail: Quantitative, verbal, logical + 3 coding questions of increasing difficulty.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.detail: Java/Python, OOP, DBMS queries, DSA basics, project deep-dive.

rounds.name: HR Interview
rounds.detail: Culture fit, willingness to learn any technology, relocation.

aptitudePatterns.sample: A pie chart of 5 expense heads - find by what percent the largest exceeds the smallest.
Two vessels have milk:water 3:1 and 5:3. In what ratio must they be mixed to get 2:1?
SEND + MORE = MONEY style logic puzzles in the InfyTQ pattern.

codingPatterns.sample: Count the number of primes in a range using a sieve, with time-limit awareness.
Check whether two strings are anagrams, ignoring case and spaces.
Rotate an N x N matrix by 90 degrees in place.

hrQuestions: You may be posted on any technology - how will you handle that?
Where do you see yourself in three years at Infosys?
Tell us about a time a team member did not deliver. What did you do?
tips: Power Programmer needs strong DSA - DP and graphs are asked.
InfyTQ certification carries real weight in the shortlisting.
